origin.description: The default is eager. The option readr.read_lazy asks for a lazy read.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: The default is eager. The option readr.read_lazy asks for a lazy read.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
old <- options(readr.read_lazy = TRUE)
on.exit(options(old), add = TRUE)
yn(should_read_lazy())
